selection.summary: Bug: notifications dropdown refresh/toggle issues and misplaced `dropup` category selector in fork/move modals (NodeBB v4.4.3). Evidence: fork-topic.tpl (h1) and move-topic.tpl (h2) import partials/category/selector-dropdown-right.tpl (h9), whose content (h0) renders a standard dropdown used by the modal category selector. threadTools.js renderMenu (h4/h16) unconditionally toggles `dropup` on `show.bs.dropdown` based on `top > window.innerHeight/2`, which misplaces the selector inside modals; patch guards the toggle with a closest('.modal, .tool-modal') check. postTools.js (h8/h15) contains the parallel dropup toggle for post tools. Notifications: header/notifications.js (h7/h17) wires `show.bs.dropdown` to async loadNotifications via requireAndCall; modules/notifications.js loadNotifications (h13/h5) re-binds `.mark-all-read` via plain `.on(...)` on each async load, stacking duplicate handlers and causing inconsistent dropdown toggle behavior; patch uses `.off().on()` before rebinding. Category selector/search init (h10/h14/h6) and fork.js modal init (h3/h12) confirm the selector wiring in the modal context.
